notes.title: #UPDATE 0.19a - Welcome, Mac users!
notes.content:
It is always good to keep growing and get the game going available even for more people, and that's why if you are a proud owner of a Macintosh, then let me say: welcome to One Last Day!

This update comes with even more content, as always, so sit down and start reading, it is worth the time.

[h1]Mac version[/h1]
This is the first and the most important new "feature" available now in O.L.D. Mac users are now able to play the game, but hey, if you have also a PC remember that you won't loose your characters, they will stay saved online.
This is the very first version of Mac, so please be aware that we will be working on further optimization and possible bug fixes, but it has been tested and it's fully playable if you are between the minimum requirements.

[h1]Interactive dynamic objects[/h1]
You've asked for it, then here you go! If you have placed a torch, campfire, antenna, bed and now you can to move, don't worry, keep pressed E key to open a new interaction pannel that will allow you more options with that object.

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/interaction.jpg[/img]

You will find that some items, like torches and campfires will have also an extra option like turn on / off. [b]Just doing a fast tap on the E key will activate the default option of that item[/b], so don't worry, you don't need to open a interface panel every time you want to light a torch or open a door.

[h1]Talking about campfires[/h1]
Until now it was used only to light a wide area, but now it is more useful than ever (and it will be even more soon). Tired of those zombies coming for underground to kill you? Want to make a camp outside in the forest but those zombies are always there? Don't worry! Now campfires will avoid these zombies coming from underground while you are within its range and also it is burning, of course.

Also, [b]staying within the range of the campfire will replenish your energy gradually[/b], so come closer and take a break.

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/campfire.jpg[/img]

Yes, it is wonderfull, but we're making things to react each other in the world, starting with fire (right now, torches and campfires). If they are under rain, don't try to make them work, they will extinguish, and of course, no effect or light is coming out. But be even more afraid from acid rain now.
[b]Acid rain will react agaisnt the fire, making a small explosion when colliding.[/b] This explosive feature is for now only working with placed torches and campfires, so try to get them in a place with a roof or extinguish them manually if you see the storm coming.

[h1]I love rain![/h1]
And that's why now you can again fill your bottles and bowls if you are under the rain (just use them like a regular item), and also staying under the rain your thirst will be gone gradually, so open your mouth and drink that rain! Well... no mouth in your character I guess... =)

[h1]A new chat system, bye bye old one[/h1]
This is not a really big change but needed since we have changed almost every UI item, so it's looking more integrated and quite better now. This new chat system is still in experimental stage, just like multiplayer, so expect a lot of improvements and fixes once we reach beta stage.
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/smallchat.jpg[/img]

There are a few more things on this update, and other few that we're preparing for a lot of new features that are coming really soon.

[b]Before leaving, in case that you have missed it, take a look to the last biggest additions / changes on One Last Day![/b]

[h1]A whole new interface, inventory and crafting system[/h1]
Inventory with slots, draggable windows, recipe learning system, shortcut key bar, better take a look by yourself.
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/craft.jpg[/img]

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/windows.jpg[/img]

[h1]New NPC spawn system[/h1]
Tired of being alone around you? This new spawn system will take care of that and will bring you some company always!

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/notalone.jpg[/img]

[h1]Some optimization tweaks, added more options to settings menu[/h1]
It is really important to get the game smoothly running for you, so this is one of our main tasks, thats why we have improve performance and added some more graphical options that you can tweak to improve your experience.


[h1]But the best thing is coming next...[/h1]
We have a lot of new features and suprises coming soon! You will be enjoying One Last Day more than ever really soon...

[i]Some short, quick patch notes[/i]
0.19a
- Mac version supported - First version, optimization and further support coming along
- Infinite levels for your characters (in preparation for character progression)
- You can know open an interaction panel with dynamic objects (torches, doors, beds...) by holding E
- Doing a fast tap to E will activate main dynamic object action (light on / off, open, set spawn point...)
- Added the option to pick up a dynamic object back from the world
- Increased spawner's spawn rate, spawn quantity remains untouched
- You are now able to light on / off placed torches and campfires
- New campfire FX effect
- Staying within the range of a campfire will now recover your energy gradually (while lighted)
- Staying within the range of a campfire will now avoid zombies coming from underground (while lighted)
- Steam achievement "Saving the carrots" changed from 200 to 30 rabbits needed to be hunted
- More tips & hints added to the loading screen
- Solved an important bug causing game getting stuck when throwing a molotov cocktail to any wild life
- Campfires and torches will now extinguish when they are directly exposed to rain
- Warning! Acid rain will now trigger an explosive reaction when colliding with fire (for now, torches and campfires, expanding this to the rest of the available game fire)
- You can collect water again by using empty bottles or bowls under the rain
- Staying under rain will now replenish your thirst slowly
- New and experimental chat system, integrated with the new UI
- Chat will now be hiding lines after a few seconds, open it (pressing enter) to see the fully cached text
- Animals will be spawning only at day and hiding at night if they can

notes.title: What's coming next on O.L.D?
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I'd like to sit down and talk to you about what's coming to the game this winter.

First, and very soon, you will see the whole new crafting system fully working. 

[h1]New crafting system[/h1]
You will be able to learn recipes, save them, and them craft them from your inventory. This will be extended along the next months, making some exclusive recipes and specific tools that you will need for the bigger recipes.

Crafting is splitted in two sides, discovering and known. The first one is almost the same that you can use now in the game, drag up to 3 ingredients to the slots and if there's something craftable, you will be able to make it by clicking the anvil. Once you crafted it, the recipe will be added to your known recipes.

Now, known recipes can be crafted directly from the items that you have in your inventory, no need to drag them to any place, just select your recipe and click "craft", be sure to have enough space in your inventory for the crafted item!

[h1]MAC version[/h1]
Early next month all Mac users will be able to get the game and play finally! As the first version, be aware that problems may appear, but as always, they will be solved ASAP!

[b]And now let's talk about what's coming after these months! Please note that this might be implemented or not, depending of the current situation[/b]

[h1]Infinite terrain (or almost)[/h1]
Starting with this, you will be able to travel without limits wherever you want. Tired of the same zone? Just walk far away! We're working on this, and first the generated terrain will be the same (like a whole map right now), but in future updates we are going to implement regions or zones. These zones will be infected and you'll need to clean them up, once cleaned you will be able to build whole buildings and place NPC's.

[h1]Customizable weapons[/h1]
Yay, silencers, sights, flashlights... we're going to add some accesories so you can customize a bit your own weapons!

[h1]Something bad... experimental multiplayer[/h1]
This is important. Before all of this new content is being added, multiplayer will be on "experimental" stage. It will be still working, however we'll focus on singleplayer, since is the most played mode with a huge difference.
When you start multiplayer mode you will be warned about experimental phase and please, report every bug.
Once singleplayer is fully working (after this winter), our main priority is to focus in multiplayer!

[h1]More things![/h1]
Yes, of course, the biggest change of the infinite terrain will bring another big changes too, like spawn system, enemies, etc... Also a huge improvement in performance, and a lot of new possibilities of gameplay!

We will keep you updated about every single new change!

Thank you and as always, enjoy :)

notes.content:

Halloween is coming and we wanted to make a little simple event for all of you.

Enjoy!

notes.title: #UPDATE 0.16a
notes.content:
Hey there!

Here we are again with new content and fixes for One Last Day.

This time you will find some cool additions and improvements that will improve your game experience.

[h1]Does it sounds good?[/h1]
Sound is important and I'm making some tweaks, adjustements and additions to the sound system.
Now the ambience sound at day will be softer and quiet, and at night, you will hear some crickets and more sounds.
Also sometimes when you were walking over some surfaces, your footsteps sound like grass always. Now this is fixed and in addition I've added a couple of new sounds for metal and wet dirt.
And talking about footsteps sounds, no more ninja zombies! They will make sounds when walking, soft sounds though.

[h1]This looks better, and works better[/h1]
Again we've improved load times and the generation itself. An improved mesh generation for terrain will avoid strange forms and work faster.
Also, some buildings were generating a bit strange too or floating, well, no more!
Now pines are much more beautiful and well generated too.

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/betterPines.jpg[/img]

[h1]Improved lighting, darker nights[/h1]
Now you should have a couple of torchs or campfires when the night falls, because after 23:00PM it gets really dark until 5:00AM, so better watch your step, find a safe place, get a torch, or do everything.

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/darker.jpg[/img]

Also lighting system has been improved, avoiding strange shadows or illumination, and making day / night cycle looking better.

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/improvedLight.jpg[/img]

[h1]Just a bit less silly[/h1]
Zombies are quite dumb, and they were doing weird things. They will keep being quite dumb, because that's our goal, but even so we have improved a bit their A.I. Now they will climb up if they can to catch you, so you won't be safe if they find the way.

[h1]And more, much more![/h1]
A new airdrop box, a little clock with in-game time, UI improvements, bug fixes, performance, etc..

Here's the full change list:
- Voxel generation (mesh generation) improved
- Morning load time reduced drastically
- No more boars spawning in the air
- NPC spawn increased (wildlife will be still hard to hunt, but at least there will be quite more to be hunted)
- New box for the airdrops added
- Effect when breaking an airdrop box improved
- Day sound ambience has been changed
- New night sound ambience added
- Lush pine. Improved generation for pines (trees)
- Added store filters to find faster the type of item you want to buy
- Current coins are now showed at the store only
- Added a footstep sound to the zombies
- World generation time improved, it should take a bit less to generate
- World generation: building generation improved, no more "flying" buildings
- Existing player footstep over some materials added
- New player footstep sounds for some materials added
- Some UI adjustements have been done
- WARNING, true dark nights!, now you will need a light source at night if you want to see something
- Now zombies won't attack you while spawning from underground
- Added a clock to the game with the current in-game time
- Solved a bug where the coin was colliding with bullets
- Zombies will now stop with an animation while climbing up
- Object placement (torchs, campfires) is now fixed and should be working as expected


Hope you enjoy this update and what's coming next too!

notes.title: #UPDATE 0.15a
notes.content:
Hey there!

How are you doing? Well I guess you are sad, the summer is ending, and we need go get back to school and work :(

But at least we're going to keep working too to bring you new updates and improve this game!

So here's come the 0.15a update, which brings new things that we're going to be working in the next weeks to improve and add more features.

[h1]New interface system[/h1]
We're starting to create the new interface system that will make interactions much more comfortable and easier, and less buggy of course. You will be able to open windows, move them and interact while your character is not moving at all, and if you need to close all of them at once, just press one button (alt) and you're ready to go.

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/interfazNueva.jpg[/img]

So expect more update into this new interface until we replace even the whole tablet (zablet) into this.

[h1]Store, buy items![/h1]
Are you tired of trying to get a specific item? Too many coins and you don't how what to do with them? Then let's go shopping!

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/store.jpg[/img]

For testing purposed all prices are discounted! Autumn sale!
This store is the very first to be in-game. All items will be delivered by an airplane in the spot you made your order, so beware of the falling box.

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/airplaneD.jpg[/img]

[h1]More to kill...and be killed[/h1]
Be careful. Now if you are standing on soft ground (dirt, grass...) zombies may come from the underground to kill you!
And at night better find a place to hide, because they are 3 times more active and you might be surrounded in a few seconds!

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/zeds.jpg[/img]

[h1]Full list of changes[/h1]
- Added a store to buy items with coins!
- Zombie bait improved
- When using zombie bait, zombies will take a little to come from the underground
- New effect and sound added when a zombie comes from the underground
- Random zombie encounters. Watch your step!
- New interface for the needs bars
- From the interface redesign: added interactions labels to open interface windows
- New interface window: options
- New interface window: store
- New interface window: help (currently being developed)
- Needs (life, hunger...) can't no longer exceed 100 points
- Other various minor bug fixes
- Now you can change game settings while playing, no need to get back to main menu
- Coin collecting range increased
- Zecola, Peepsee and Moonsir use shows now as "Drink" and no more as "Eat"
- Added a "pulsing" animation over the icon if any need (life, hunger...) is under 25%
- For testing purposes, the current store will have 80+ items available to buy for now (this will be reduced and distributed along other stores in the map in further updates)
- Added variables to store system (buying price, comission, selling) to improve it and add more in further updates
- Every purchase through the store will be delivered by an airplane in a "public" box in your position, meaning that it will be visible for every player in the network if you play multiplayer
- While you are on solid ground (rock, a building, etc...) zombies won't hear you and won't spawn
- Now zombies will spawn around you more 3 times while you are not on solid ground at night (0:00AM until 7:00AM)

[b]Note[/b]: uploading update, it will be available in a few minutes. Keep your game always updated, this update may need some quick fixes.

notes.title: #UPDATE 0.14a
notes.content:
It's me, Mot! Again...

Although I haven't finished at all everything that we wanted to add in this 0.14a update, I think it's time to upload it and let you enjoy fixes and new content added so far.

So, what's new? Take a look to the changelog!

- Added new item: Zombie Bait (as a throwing "weapon")
- New zombie animation: coming from underground
- Added the architecture version you are currently running (64 or 32bits) 
- Added new glow effect support
- Zombie bait can be broken into the ground to make zombies spawn around
- Solved a bug causing arrows colliding with an "invisible wall" while lying
- Added an option to the main menu "Camera sensitivy". You can tweak how fast you can move the character's camera (mouse sensivity)
- Added another option to the main menu allowing you to invert this camera movement in X and Y axes
- New account coin system added
- Coins added to the game, you will be able to collect them by doing various tasks. Account linked.
- Item material finally activated: leather
- New item material added: bone
- New recipe added: bone dust (1 bone + 1 leather + 1 stone)
- New item material added: bone dust
- New recipe added: zombie bait (2 bone dust + 1 water bottle + 5 seed)
- Some item descriptions have been changed
- Increased zombie limit per map


Boring? Yeah well, let me explain you a bit what's new and what's coming next. First, as you may know, now you can craft some Zombie baits.
These are like throwing weapons (like molotov cocktails) and when it crashes, some zombies will come around the spot from the underground.

[h1]Zombie baits[/h1]
Crafting this may you require to do some researching. This is where we added a couple of new materials: bones and bone dust!

Bones are collected from skeletons as you may know. To craft a zombie bait, first you need to craft bone dust. This is the recipe:

[i]1 Stone + 1 Bone + 1 Leather = 1 Bone dust[/i]

Leather can be obtained by killing rabbits and boars or you can find it also by breaking skeletons.

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/screenshots/items.jpg[/img]

Once you have the dust ready, you need this to craft a fully working zombie bait

[i]1 glass water + 5 seeds + 2 bone dust = 1 zombie bait[/i]

How to get water? How to get seeds? I wonder how to...
Yeah, of couse I know how to get them, but I'm really wicked muwhaha!
 
[h1]Coins[/h1]
Too much work? Don't worry, we have added coins. Right now [b]you can't use them[/b] but you can collect them. Wondering when you will be able to use them? Really soon, at this moment, we are making a new store and interface system, so it won't take too long! That's because we are letting you to collect coins from now.
They are shared between your characters (account linked), so don't worry if you loose your character by accident or want to delete it.

[h1]Options, and more coming[/h1]
We want to improve the user experience, and the best way to do it is by listening to you. By demand we have added some new options to the main menu, however we're adding even more to improve your game experience.

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/screenshots/options.jpg[/img]


[b]This update is making its way to Steam right now, so you should be able to get it soon, just be patient, it will take a while =)[/b]

Now time to get back to work, you can't imagine how many things we have to add to the game!

[b]Note:[/b] this update contains some fixes and performance tweaks that are not showing since it's very specific. Other updates and fixes required or suggested by users are right now under development and they will be out as soon as possible!

[b]Note 2:[/b] if you have an item called "fine leather" or "superb leather", drop it, it's not used and probably it won't be used. These drops have been replaced by "Leather".

Thank you!

notes.title: Next update and further
notes.content:
Hi!

Are you enjoying the game so far? Well, there's a lot more coming! Be prepared.

Now I'll talk about what's coming on this next update and later.

[h1]Commerce system[/h1]
You have chosen and we did too, so first the system will be in-game driven.
On the very next update you won't be able to access stores yet, but you can collect coins already. These coins are account linked so don't worry if you loose your character or your map, you will keep them always.

[b]How do you get coins so far?[/b]
Every enemy you kill will drop a random ammount of coins in the ground. These coins are not usual items and you only need to walk over them to catch them. Coins will only drop if you made some direct damage to your enemy, so if a zombie gets killed by a lightning, it won't drop any coin.

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/screenshots/coin.png[/img]

Edit.: you will be able to collect these coins by breaking boxes and skeletons too!

[b]And what's next? (on next updates)[/b]
We want to add two kind of stores, the first one is using your antenna, you will be able to buy items by using it. It will have a random list of items that will be updated every day (in-game time).
The second one it's making world stores with NPC vendors. These vendors will be inside a cabin and you won't be able to steal them. Every vendor may have different items, but they will keep the same list.

[h1]Baits and NPC spawn control[/h1]
Some of you have seen that sometimes NPC's are quite expanded around the map, and you need to walk a lot until you find a group of zombies (they were on party).
So I've created the very first game's bait! The Zombie Bait!

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/screenshots/zombieBait.png[/img]

You will be able to craft these bottles and then you can use them as a throwing weapon, like a molotov cocktail. When it breaks, a random number of zombies will spawn around the spot, coming from the underground.

This will be available on the next update coming soon!

So this is a starting bait, we want to add more baits so you can camp and hunt creatures you want.


Hope you like the game so far and what's coming next too!

Thank you all for your support.

notes.title: Let's see what's coming
notes.content:
I'm taking a coding-break, I need some brainy breathing.

Since all of you are playing the game now it is working I want to talk about what are you playing now and what are you going to find next.

[h1]Performance, bug fixes[/h1]
This is a big priority. You need to be able to play, even if this is an Early Access and you know it, you must be able to play it!
There are minor bugs (something goes wrong just for a moment or a little invisible triangle on the terrain), these bug are going to be fixed, but it's not a priority. [b]Then, there are main bugs and problems, like not able to start the game, continuous crashing and so. These bugs are our main priority of work, we need a stable base to work with.[/b]

[h1]Enemies? Yes, but what about if your enemy is the whole world?[/h1]
This world is really dangerous. When we have a story mode available you will find exactly why, but in the meanwhile, you can experience it.
Right now you need to be aware of acid rain, big falls, zombies, starving and if you play multiplayer, other players.
[b]So what can you expect next? [/b]
- Caves are quite relaxing, right? Well, don't get too comfortable, there will be dangerous gases that might be toxic or even explosive.
- What about this old civilization? They left some mines on the terrain! Watch your step.
- Don't bother a boar or it will kick your pretty ːsteamhappyːss
- Enjoying a relaxing walk into the old ruins and the forest? What if a group of zombies came from the underground? Better be ready.

[h1]Inventory and character redesign[/h1]
Since a few weeks we're redesigning these two things, and we need a bit more. We want to improve the way the player can interact and progress, we don't like the current tablet. It will be still a "tablet" view, but the interface will be much more comfortable.



Well, now I need to get back to work! Have an idea? Post it in the comments!

Oh, and don't be shy, try the editor, make a building, and share it!

notes.title: UPDATE # The beginning of a new world
notes.content:
[h1]This update will change drastically world generation, beware of performance problems and bugs and report them as soon as you can so we can fix it![/h1]

Hey! How are you doing?

Has been a long time without an update, I know, and I apologize, but now I bring you something big.

At first it might seem not a really big update, but we have changed a lot of things that will bring big things!

Let's start with "What's new".

[h1]Building editor[/h1]
My favourite addition to the game. Now you can make your own buildings or even small cities or towns in a editor / creative mode.
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/Images/Screenshots/editor1.jpg[/img]

Fly around freely and start building your own creations. Then, save it and when generating a new map you will have the chance to use your creations into your map randomly!
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/Images/Screenshots/editor2.jpg[/img]

But that's not all, [b]you can share your buildings over the internet with other users and use community made buildings into your new generated maps![/b].

If you made something cool and you think it will be awesome to be included into the game, just press "Share", we will take a look and if everythings is cool, your building is officially into the game!

Making a new map? You will be asked if you want to use community made buildings from the internet, say yes and they will be added randomly! 

[h1]New world generation system[/h1]
Tired of flat, repetitive map? That's over! We have changed the map generation, now you can find hills, different terrain heights and improved building generation.
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/Images/Screenshots/newmapgen1.jpg[/img]

The world it's looking the way we wanted, an apocalyptic world that the nature has taken back. Buildings are now procedurally destroyed, move or buried, so the same building you find may be buried, built-in into another building, mostly destroyed and more possibilities!
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/Images/Screenshots/night.png[/img]

[h1]Into the depths[/h1]
Another cool feature we have added to the map generator is terrain height and depth, and of course, a cave system.

These caves are quite big and are all over the map, so beware you don't fall into one of them, finding the exit will be hard.
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/Images/Screenshots/cave1.jpg[/img]

Caves are a totally new thing, so you can expect cool content and additions to discover in future updates. So far you can explore them, break bones to get loot (like the boxes from the surface), and, another cool thing, explore buried buildings that aren't generated in the surface such bunkers!
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/Images/Screenshots/cave2.jpg[/img]

[h1]More?[/h1]
Of course, we have made some fixes and improved stability and performance, however this update might bring some performance spikes.
Also we have solved some kind of bug that were causing FPS dropping a lot after playing the same map for a long time. Now you can play as long as you want!

Main menu has been modified and improved with new sounds, options and more, take a look.

[h1]Things removed / deactivated[/h1]
We have deactivated surface water temporary, you can still find water in pools and underground, at the bottom of the map. The reason is that we're developing dynamic water like very voxel game.

[h1]Future content[/h1]
Expect imminent content for the underground, new buildings, fixes and some surprises!
Also we're going to add support for OSX (Mac) soon. Then, Linux!


[h1]Discount[/h1]
The game will be greatly discounted for 14 days. This is a great opportunity for all those players that weren't sure enough to spend 13$ on a unfinished game, you will be able to get it for a much lower price.

However, to be fair to the users that bought the game before for the whole price they will get some exclusive items in a future.

Scavenger weapons are included into this promotion.

[h1]Important[/h1]
Big update, you need to update to keep playing. Update avaiable on next hours, keep the game updated!

notes.title: More news about the update
notes.content:
Hey!

As you know we're doing a big update.

We're taking a bit more than expected because we want everything smooth and fully working.

I'm here to show you some progress!

[h1]New map generation[/h1]
As you know, there's a new map generator, including new terrain heights, slopes, canyons and a new building distribution. Now the generator may merge even terrain with buildings and / or with other buildings. This adds a perfect feeling of post-apocalyptic world that the nature has taken back!

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/Images/Screenshots/generation.png[/img]

I'd like to add that temporary we have deactivated the water and different heights. You can still find water in the underground. This is because we're doing dynamic water and it's taking a bit more.

[h1]Caves and underground[/h1]
Yay! We've added underground generation. You won't find minerals and things like this in the caves, as instead, you will be able to find special herbs, buried old buildings (such as bunkers and so), skeletons, and dangers. We are adding more underground content in future updates!

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/Images/Screenshots/underground.png[/img]

[h1]Building / map editor[/h1]
What is the best way to add more content to the game? Letting the community create their own content! Starting from a building editor, you will be able to create your own buildings and then send them to be reviewed and approved.

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/Images/Screenshots/editorl.png[/img]

Then, every user will be able to allow the map generator to take random buildings from the internet and generate a new map using them!

[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/Images/Screenshots/editor2.png[/img]

Please note that the interface and some other things are not finished yet and may be changed this week!

[h1]Performance[/h1]
This is serious for us. We're trying to keep improving the game's performance, and we're doing well. In this version you will find that the game no longer crash or take too many memory after playing the same map for a long time.

[h1]What's next?[/h1]
We want to add farming in this update too, let's see if that's possible, but it will be soon.
After the update, we are going to make this version stable and we'll keep adding new content to the map, but most important we're going back to player interactions, items and so.

We want to thank you all for your support, let's keep improving the game!

notes.title: [UPCOMING] Let's talk about the next update
notes.content:
Hi everyone ^^

We'd like to talk about the next update and the current state of the game.
Right now this version is quite stable, as for a few bugs. 

This bugs or unfinished features will be fully removed and / or changed in the next updates. Since they aren't killing the gameplay or making the game unplayable, we're focused on the biggest content that will fix them too.

Now, what's coming on One Last Day?

[h1]Natural world[/h1]
If you purchased the game on day 1, at launch you might remember that the terrain was a bit...ugly and unrealistic. After an update we improved the generation a lot, making it more realistic, but this is not enough!
We're bringing soon slopes, canyons and and different terrain levels. Also caves and underground system is planned.

[h1]Harder to survive[/h1]
Take a walk right now, you will see a thousand mushroom and food around you. [h1]Farming[/h1]
Have you a home? Then make your own food. You will be able to farm starting with a few crops, we are adding more on future updates!

[h1]Buildings everywhere?[/h1]
Right now you can see high buildings everywhere. You will be able to find them in this update too, but instead, the bigger buildings will be together on a kind of a destroyed city or towns. Far away, at forests, mountains and so you will be able to find smaller buildings.

[h1]Dangerous wildlife[/h1]
Better don't bother a wild boar...

All these features will allow us to make even more features like cooking, improved crafting, and more!

And when is all of this coming?
We're planning to release a big update after the summer sale with all these features and maybe more, stay tuned!

notes.title: UPDATE #6: More content and optimization!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
This update is quite big after all, read it please! You will find useful information.

We come with new things to be played.

While we are working on a bigger patch that will bring bigger additions to the game (keep an eye, we'll talk about it soon) we're releasing smaller content. Some was already done but pending to be implemented, some is totally new.

Let's start!

[h1]Your own chest[/h1]
First, and finally, you can craft your own chests or boxes to store your things wherever you want with up to 7 slots.
In order to craft it you will need 5 processed wood, 5 scrap and 3 ropes.
No need of wood support to be placed, craft and place!
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/screenshots/cofre.png[/img]

[h1]Climbing time[/h1]
Also finally you can craft your own ladders. They can be placed directly and can be climbed like ivy. Just be careful, it's really weak.
To craft them you only need 2 processed wood and 2 ropes.
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/screenshots/escaleras.png[/img]

[h1]Safe is good[/h1]
And more craftable objects! Now you can craft windows to place them wherever you want. We recommend using the rounded placing mode (by clicking the mouse wheel).
There are 2 kind of windows, both can be closed and opened like a door.
First, the basic, a wooden window
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/screenshots/window.png[/img]
Craft them with 4 processed wood and 5 nails

And if you like the views, then you have to choose this one
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/screenshots/windowbars.png[/img]
Just be warned that the bullets can go through the bars. You can craft them with 2 processed wood, 3 nails and 5 scrap.

[h1]Keep your enemies away[/h1]
And now you can craft (also!) throwing knives!
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/screenshots/throwingKnife.png[/img]
They are really useful and can be crafted by just using a stick, a stone and a rope. Cheap and good. [b]However, if you only have the stone, you can throw them too now![/b].
[b]An advice:[/b] use stones or knives to detonate the grenade from the armored zombie's belt.

[h1]This is mine![/h1]
This is a small thing, but important. You can recover now almost every arrow, stone or knife you throw or shoot. Really useful.

[h1]More notes[/h1]
There are a lot of changes and additions in this patch. Some of most important that you should care about are these:
- Airplane drops now last 450 seconds instead of 150
- Parachute from drop boxes have changed to a more visible model
- Solved some bugs involved with inventory and free slots
- Arrows wont damage armored zombies anymore
- Arrows, throwing knives and stones may now detonate the grande from the armored zombie's belt
[b]- Added a breaking indicator effect on voxel (cracks)[/b]
- Breaking voxel effect improved

[h1]This patch is quite big, so you may expect some fixes soon as it's needed.[/h1]

[h1]Patch available on next 20 minutes. Version changed to 0.11a, you need to update to keep playing.[/h1]

notes.title: UPDATE #5: New content, fixes and optimization
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Like I said, here is it! Another update but this time with more content.
Then let's talk about what is new. Starting with a new map generation.

[h1]Map generation[/h1]
This new map generation is right now pretty similar to the previous, however it will allow much more control and future implementations. Also, the generated terrain is now much more realistic and with less water! More to explore.
Ah, and no more floating buildings over the water.
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/screenshots/bettergen.png[/img]

[h1]New animal type[/h1]
Introducing the pheasant! New winged animal implemented. It was done before, but not implemented. Now you can hunt flying birds.
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/screenshots/pheasantNew.png[/img]

[h1]Airdrops / first map event[/h1]
Yay! Now you can have an airplane dropping resources over your map at morning (9 AM). It will drop weapons and supplies.
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/screenshots/supplieairplane.png[/img]

In order to get the airplane flying around, you need to craft an antenna first, and to do so you need Scrap and a Transmitter, that you can get from Armored Zombies. Then place your new antenna anywhere and the airplane will fly around every morning.
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/screenshots/antenna.png[/img]

The airplane will drop two kind of boxes, supplies and weapons. This boxes contains a higher drop for those items that you can get in the world but only if you are lucky. Also it may contain exclusive things like a placeable mine!
[img]http://bloodwolfstudio.com/OLD/images/screenshots/mineNew.png[/img]


[h1]More things![/h1]
- Buildings will no longer keep generating over the water
- NPC limit added to the map 
- Character stuck (animation) fixed
- Now you need to generate the map in order to save it
- Lightnings effect optimized, no more FPS drops
- Blood effect optimized
- Break block effect changed
- New item added: transmitter, dropped by armored zombies
- New recipe added: antenna, craftable with scrap (20) and transmitters (2)

[b]Version changed to 0.1pa, you need to update your game in order to keep playing[/b]

[h1]Important[/h1]
This update is bigger than usual, please, keep your game updated for possible fixes.

Update available on Steam in 10-15 minutes.

notes.title: Things that we are working on
notes.content:
Today there won't be an update. However I'd like to talk you about the things we're working on and what you will find on the next weeks.


[b]What you will find on the next week / month?[/b]
First of all, more optimization and more fixes. This game needs to have a stable, consistent base to work on because we are going to add a lot of things.

Second, the Zablet. As you may know the tablet is being redesigned into a 2D, more confortable way free of bugs. This leads me to the next point.

Third, more content. Right now the only thing to do in game is to survive, kill zombies, search for a better gear and build your base. Yeah, not bad, but we want more! The Zablet redesign will allow us to add advanced crafting, cooking and procedural tasks (kind of missions). Also, you will be able to attach some cool accesories or attachments to your weapons.

Server search! As we can't purchase a large dedicated server yet we want to provide you a way to do your own server and show it into the game, so everyone can join.

And more, much more. The character is being redesigned too (this will take a bit more) so we can't add new weapons types, accesories, animations and actions.

We're not changing version this time since this changes are not really big.

Hope you enjoy, and thank you!!

PS. The update may take 10 mins to become available.

notes.title: Bug fixing and next update
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
We hope you all are enjoying the game.

We are aware about the crashing thing while playing around 40-60 mins and we're working to fix it as soon as possible.

But that's not all. We promised content update every 2 weeks but this bug fixing patch is bringing new content too. Be ready to hide from the acid rain, lightnings and find the loot that the plane dropped at the morning!


[b]Something at work[/b]
And something else that I'd like to say is that the tablet system (yep, that awesome "Zablet") is being redesigned for a more confortable and intuitive way to use it.

We're also redesigning the character's control, this will allow new weapon types (some surprises) and interactions.

And about the multiplayer, you can currently start your game with your own server by routing the 25000 port to your private IP. If you ever made a server game for a sandbox game you will know how to do it.
However you might not, that's because we're working to bring a "Server search" feature, and hopefully to make some dedicated servers soon.

Thank you!!
